text:
Forsta AP Fonden trimmed its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.7% in the first quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 175,287 shares of the iPhone makers stock after selling 21,100 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 1.0% of Forsta AP Fondens investment portfolio, making the stock its 29th biggest holding. Forsta AP Fondens holdings in Apple were worth $29,410,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other large investors have also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Stokes & Hubbell Capital Management LLC raised its stake in Apple by 7.9% during the 4th quarter. Stokes & Hubbell Capital Management LLC now owns 70,698 shares of the iPhone makers stock valued at $11,964,000 after purchasing an additional 5,197 shares during the period. Ingalls & Snyder LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the 4th quarter valued at approximately $29,116,000 . Wealth Enhancement Advisory Services LLC raised its stake in Apple by 516.7% during the 4th quarter. Wealth Enhancement Advisory Services LLC now owns 36,018 shares of the iPhone makers stock valued at $6,378,000 after purchasing an additional 30,178 shares during the period. Plancorp LLC raised its stake in Apple by 27.2% during the 4th quarter. Plancorp LLC now owns 18,183 shares of the iPhone makers stock valued at $3,082,000 after purchasing an additional 3,890 shares during the period. Finally, Steward Partners Investment Advisory LLC raised its stake in Apple by 24.3% during the 4th quarter. Steward Partners Investment Advisory LLC now owns 285,924 shares of the iPhone makers stock valued at $48,387,000 after purchasing an additional 55,874 shares during the period. 58.61% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors.
Several analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. Maxim Group raised Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating in a research note on Thursday, May 31st . New Street Research downgraded Apple from a neutral rating to a sell rating in a research note on Monday, August 20th . Loop Capital lifted their price objective on Apple from $195.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a buy rating in a research note on Friday, July 6th . Macquarie set a $214.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a research note on Wednesday, August 15th . Finally, Morgan Stanley lifted their price objective on Apple from $214.00 to $232.00 and gave the stock an overweight rating in a research note on Tuesday, July 24th . Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-one have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of Buy and an average price target of $221.00 .
Shares of AAPL traded up $2.60 during midday trading on Friday, hitting $227.63 . 43,173,553 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 26,331,752. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $149.16 and a 52-week high of $228.87 . The firm has a market cap of $1,106.05 billion , a P/E ratio of 24.72, a P/E/G ratio of 1.75 and a beta of 1.16. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st . The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16 . Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion . During the same period last year, the business posted $1.67 earnings per share. The companys quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. sell-side analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.68 earnings per share for the current year.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, August 16th . Stockholders of record on Monday, August 13th were given a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date was Friday, August 10th . This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.28%. Apples dividend payout ratio is currently 31.70%.
